name: McDowell
gaps: Parcels are NC/McDowell Parcels (CAMA + polygons) (https://www.webgis.net/arcgis/rest/services/NC/McDowell/MapServer/2). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
Source query returned 1789 rows; 1736 stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the parcel-id and geometry checks.
Pass 2 enrichment is from card pass2 (tax ok, sale partial). Pass 2 counted 317 NCDOT 2022 AADT stations. NCDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.
Pass 2 sale: Price not on REST; ITSPublicMD AppraisalCard PDF has SALES DATA grid (BOOK/PAGE/MO/YR/SALES PRICE).
Property-appraiser links are stored from the card or pass-2 pattern and were not requested. Owner phone and email are not ingested.
